title: Witness on fatal ICE shooting in Minneapolis: "We just watched a murder by our government"
summary: An ICE officer fatally shot a woman in her car in Minneapolis on Wednesday. Video shows the woman appearing to back up her car as one agent attempts to open the driver's side door. As she begins to pull away, another officer fires through the windshield. Nicole Sganga spoke with witnesses about what happened. Warning: the video in this story may be disturbi…
